summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong Stock Exchange rules reporting a routine share repurchase. On June 3, 2026, the company repurchased 957,500 ordinary shares at an average price of HKD 20.829 per share, representing 0.1022% of existing issued shares before the event. The repurchased shares are held as treasury shares. The filing is a standard post-trade disclosure for ongoing buyback programs, not a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or capital return event. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are noted. This is a routine operational filing with no event-driven implications.
